name: Ragnarok🌟
description:
While airborne, right click to lock in place and charge a mace throw that generates [effect:torque][dark-gray]torque[/dark-gray][/effect] based on smash damage upon landing, then slam down to it, [term:stun][dark-gray]stunning[/dark-gray][/term] enemies within 5 blocks. Standard attacks deal 25% of torque as chain lightning damage.

Mythical enchantment discovered on the relic [gradient:gold:aqua]Supercell[/gradient].

effects.explanation: Torque persists for 4 standard attacks, refreshing whenever torque is generated.
